title: binornd

gpu_support.notes: RunMat currently generates samples on the host RNG path.

description: `binornd(n,p)` generates binomial random samples for number of trials `n` and success probability `p`. Size-vector and dimension-list forms are supported.
behaviors: `n` and `p` support scalar expansion and matching array shapes.
Without explicit size arguments, the output shape is the scalar-expanded parameter shape.
With explicit size arguments, nonscalar parameters must match the requested shape.
`n` must be a nonnegative integer and `p` must be in `[0,1]`.

faqs.question: Can n be fractional?
faqs.answer: No. RunMat requires `n` to be a nonnegative integer trial count.
